thread:
Maya: noticed surge in GET /snapshots/tenant-42 around CMK rotation window, ~130 hits in 7m.
Dan: can you drop the raw logs?
Maya: logs:
```
2026-03-20T03:09:58Z GET /snapshots/tenant-42/2026-03-19-22:12 user=svc-backup-region-a size=12MB UA=""
... repeated ~130x
```
Priya: rotation started 03:08Z, ended 03:15Z per EncOps.
Luke: we rolled a RBAC cleanup 01:50Z removing legacy-uploader wide-read. shouldn't affect svc-backup-region-a.
Dan: hypothesis: mis-scoped ephemeral grant issued to a canary principal around 03:07-03:10 then downloader retried during re-encryption.
Maya: but svc-backup-region-a isn't in allowed list for tenant-42 - why is it reading?
Luke: checking grants... found a short-lived grant to svc-uploader-canary at 03:09Z with resource pattern buckets/*-canary, but our grant template had a bug: wildcard expanded to buckets/* for some templates.
Priya: action: correlate object-store logs with KMS audit and token issuance. SQL join example:
```
SELECT o.time,o.principal,o.user_agent,k.event_type
FROM object_store_logs o
LEFT JOIN kms_audit k ON o.request_id=k.request_id
WHERE o.path LIKE '/snapshots/tenant-42/%'
AND o.time BETWEEN '2026-03-20T03:05:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T03:20:00Z';
```
SRE Bot: alert created INC-20260320-77 attached logs.
Maya: missing user-agent on many GETs - looks like script.
Ben: uploader dependency uses requests with default retry; if retries fire during Decrypt failures you get rapid repeated GETs. Recommend bumping lib + add exponential backoff.
Priya: quick mitigations suggested:
- revoke any ephemeral grants not scoped to tenant-42
- add WAF rule to block object GETs with empty user-agent
- add a short pause in CMK rotation pipeline for non-critical reads
Dan: also add post-rotation validation: HEAD snapshot before full GET to avoid large transfers during transient decrypt errors.
Maya: adding runbook update: cross-check KMS Decrypt logs, object GET spikes, and token issuers. Add RBAC rollback steps if mis-scope found.
Luke: opening PR to tighten canary grant template to require exact bucket prefix and explicit tenant tag.
Priya: drafting ES/Sigma correlation rule: if >50 GETs for same snapshot in 10m by >1 principal then P1 alert.
EncOps Bot: cmk-tenant-42 rotation completed 03:15Z rot-id=rot-20260320-07
Maya: initial conclusion: mis-scoped canary grant + retry loop in uploader caused internal noise, no evidence of external exfil. Keeping incident open until PRs & mitigations merged.
Dan: good work, please add the token issuance query to the runbook and record remediation steps.
Maya: will update runbook and paste PR links here when ready.
Ben: after patch, let's run chaos test for CMK rotations and ensure uploader handles transient Decrypt errors safely.
Maya: assigning follow-ups: @Luke PR, @Priya alert rule, @Ben dependency bump, @Maya runbook. Close when merged.
